Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon] names.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon].")

Effect: The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon].
[On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 8000 DP or less. 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack until the end of their turn.
[End of Attack] By deleting this Digimon, gain 1 memory.
Special Play Condition: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
